from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFinancialRecord(BaseModel):
    """One company's reported non-operating expenses for the period in question."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in this document")
    line_item_name: Literal["营业外支出"] = Field(description="The line item name as specified in the task")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported amount for this line item")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit if specified (e.g., '元')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period covered by this report (e.g., '2024年第一季度')")
    previous_period_amount: float | None = Field(description="The comparable amount from the previous period if reported")
    
class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_records: list[CompanyFinancialRecord]
